storyCards.fact:
Modest Mouse's "Dashboard" reached #61 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #61 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 6 weeks on the chart.

Dashboard was released in 2007.

Album: We Were Dead Before The Ship Even Sank (2007).
